practiceReport.archetypeNote: Standard NFL positional availability baseline (78% Questionable conversion).
factors: Officially ruled Out on weekly game status report
practiceReport.beatComment: The Colts released starting quarterback Daniel Jones after a disastrous 26-3 Thursday night loss to the Texans in Week 11. With Richardson in line to start moving forward, Leonard is the next QB up on the depth chart. The second-year pro has been with the Colts since 2025, when he played in five games, completing 39 of 67 attempts for 415 yards, two touchdowns and three interceptions. He also rushed six times for 27 yards and two touchdowns.

practiceReport.name: Seth McGowan
practiceReport.archetypeNote: Perimeter speed/cut position (RB) — requires full deceleration/burst clearance on lower-body tags (76% Questionable baseline).
factors: Missed prior game without practice participation — awaiting Wednesday report
practiceReport.beatComment: McGowan was injured just before halftime while returning a kickoff. He was deemed questionable to return at the beginning of the third quarter and subsequently was ruled out shortly thereafter. The rookie running back gained seven yards on three carries and caught his only target for one yard before exiting while adding 117 yards on three kickoff returns. Jonathan Taylor should continue to get most of the work at running back for the Colts for the rest of the game, and DJ Giddens should handle whatever backfield snaps that Taylor doesn't get.

irAndReserveTracker.name: Alec Pierce
irAndReserveTracker.byeWeekNote: Season-ending IR — ineligible to return in 2026
irAndReserveTracker.beatNote: The 3-8 Colts traded both Josh Downs and Keenan Allen ahead of the NFL trade deadline, and now it appears they'll err on the side of caution with Pierce for the remainder of what has turned into a lost season for the team. With that in mind, Pierce will be able to turn his focus toward returning to full health in advance of the 2027 NFL campaign. Heading into next Sunday's game against the Giants, the Colts will proceed with a WR corps comprised of Laquon Treadwell, Deion Burks, Anthony Gould, Ashton Dulin, Nick Westbrook-Ikhine and Quez Watkins.
